content.short: Foreon Network is a decentralized prediction market on Cardano for trading on the outcome of future events.
content.description: Foreon Network is a decentralized prediction market protocol built on the Cardano blockchain, enabling users to trade on the predicted outcomes of future events. By utilizing a pari-mutuel betting system, Foreon provides an information marketplace where participants can forecast results in sports, politics, and finance. The platform leverages the Aiken smart contract language and stablecoins like Djed and USDM to ensure low-fee, secure, and non-volatile settlements. With its $FRN token and unique NFT chips, Foreon empowers a community-driven ecosystem for unbiased real-time forecasts.
